full_judgment: 3. The suit was filed seeking recovery of possession of the land described in schedule 'Ka' and for a direction to prepare and publish the khatian in respect of the land described in schedule 'Kha' in the name of the plaintiff. After the institution of the suit the plaintiff filed an application under Order XXXIX, rules 1 and 2 of the Code of Civil Procedure seeking temporary injunction and the Court passed an order directing the parties to maintain status quo in respect of the 'Kha' schedule land till final hearing of the petition filed seeking temporary injunction.
